description:
The remaining fourteen survey harness crates under `dev/active/` still depend on `dev/tools/tuning-campaign-support` through depth-counting relative paths. They adopt the depth-independent form recorded for the first harness crates.

## Background

Crates (under `dev/active/`): `4c1e441f/survey/gemm-arm`, `53c5a8c0/survey/arms`, `6c6b09b1/survey/analysis`, `6c6b09b1/survey/arm-common`, `6fb89a3c/survey/gf2-side`, `ad2a6a58/survey/axpy-arm`, `c077a88b/survey/harness`, `c7113c5a/survey/gf2-side`, `f63a2464/survey/arms`, `26465e6c/survey/gf2-side`, `5cbb6545/survey/gf2-side`, `eda07788/survey/analysis`, `eda07788/survey/gf2-side`, `eda07788/survey/nr-derate`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each changed crate builds from its current location and from a copy one directory level deeper.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each harness `Cargo.toml` changes only in that dependency declaration, once; the commit records each edit.
- [hard] REQ-03: Before the change, the benchmark-acceptance verdicts for every committed `zen3-benchmark-receipt-v1` receipt are recorded, and after the change they are identical, so committed receipts keep verifying through their byte-identical snapshot copies.
- [hard] REQ-04: No historical-path allow-list or hard-coded `dev/` path remains in the changed consumer; code review checks the change against `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`.
- [hard] REQ-05: Each of the fourteen crates uses the dependency form recorded in the harness dependency-form record.

## Notes

A digest-pinned harness manifest may change once, to the depth-independent form.
title: Apply the depth-independent tool dependency to the remaining harness crates
